prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic contemporary city portrait of an approved adult man against a modern tiled architectural wall.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult man with natural textured hair and dark rectangular sunglasses, wearing a gradient sweatshirt from soft light grey to deep black, loose black pants, and a smartwatch on his left wrist. He stands confidently with relaxed posture.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical medium-full framing with sleek tiled wall, reflective glass windows, distant buildings, street textures, and shallow urban depth.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Ambient natural daylight, soft shadows and highlights, lifelike skin and fabric, contemporary minimal city mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic high-detail fashion portrait, vertical framing, sharp subject, shallow depth, realistic glass, tile, clothing, hair, and watch texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-realistic vertical contemporary city portrait of an approved adult man with natural textured hair and dark rectangular sunglasses standing confidently against a modern tiled architectural wall. Dress him in a gradient sweatshirt fading from soft light grey to deep black, loose black pants, and a smartwatch. Include reflective windows, distant buildings, street textures, ambient daylight, soft shadows, lifelike skin and fabric, and a contemporary minimal fashion mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, exact face match, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, random text, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted architecture
